title: Checkout Pool Exhaustion
description: Checkout requests time out. Instances are healthy, but active DB connections are at the configured limit.

nodes.text: Checkout requests time out. Instances are healthy, but active DB connections are at the configured limit.

actions.label: Inspect pool metrics
actions.result: Active connections climb after each payment-provider timeout; idle connections never recover.

actions.label: Increase pool size
actions.result: Timeouts pause, then the larger pool saturates and database memory pressure rises.

nodes.text: The incident continues. Temporary relief did not address the underlying cause.
observations: Timeouts pause, then the larger pool saturates and database memory pressure rises.
The team still needs a diagnosis.

actions.label: Inspect pool metrics
actions.result: Active connections climb after each payment-provider timeout; idle connections never recover.

nodes.text: The first evidence narrows the fault domain.
observations: Active connections climb after each payment-provider timeout; idle connections never recover.

actions.label: Trace timeout path
actions.result: A missing finally/try-with-resources path leaves connections checked out.

actions.label: Patch resource cleanup without verification
actions.result: The unverified change creates risk and the incident is escalated after the recovery window expires.

nodes.text: Evidence now supports a specific root cause.
observations: A missing finally/try-with-resources path leaves connections checked out.

actions.label: Patch resource cleanup
actions.result: The guarded cleanup is deployed. Pool usage returns to baseline and checkout recovers.

nodes.text: Service indicators remain healthy through the observation window.
observations: The guarded cleanup is deployed. Pool usage returns to baseline and checkout recovers.

nodes.text: The response window closes with customer impact unresolved.
observations: The incident is handed to the next response team.

rootCause: An exception path failed to close database connections, steadily exhausting the HikariCP pool.

review.explanation: An exception path failed to close database connections, steadily exhausting the HikariCP pool.
learningNotes: Use evidence to narrow the fault domain before changing production.
Temporary symptom relief is not the same as removing a root cause.
